abort.already_configured: This Lumagen device is already configured.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Lumagen device. Please check your connection settings and ensure the device is powered on.

reconfigure.description: Update the IP address and port of your Lumagen's TCP-to-serial adapter.
reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Lumagen Connection

user.description: Enter the IP address and port of your Lumagen's TCP-to-serial adapter.
user.title: Configure Lumagen Connection

error.invalid_color: Enter a 6-digit hex color, e.g. ffffff.
error.invalid_pattern: Invalid value. Characters must be between space and lowercase z (the | and ~ characters and curly braces are not allowed); end caps need exactly two characters; fill/empty need one.
error.volume_entity_required: Choose a volume entity to enable the volume display.

data_description.aspect_ratios: Select which aspect ratios appear in the Aspect Ratio menu. Unselected ratios will not be commandable.

data_description.keepalive_interval: Probe the link after this many seconds without any data. Default 30 s.
data_description.watchdog: After each command, expect a reply within the timeout or reconnect. Auto uses the Lumagen's command echo when Echo-RS232 is On, otherwise appends a ZQS00 query. Off = keepalive only.

connection.description: How quickly a dead serial link is detected. The integration only reports Connected once the Lumagen itself answers.
connection.title: Connection

osd_colors.description: Colors for messages sent by Home Assistant (volume, OSD services). Applied about 12 s after each power-on. This affects all RS232 OSD messages.
osd_colors.title: OSD Colors

data.label: Label
data.min_max_text: Show Min / Max at the ends
data.mute_persist: Keep mute on screen until unmuted

data_description.empty_char: Character for the unused part of the bar, or None for blank.
data_description.end_caps: Brackets around the bar, or None. Type any two characters for custom caps.
data_description.fill_char: Pick Solid for a block bar or type any single character.
data_description.label: Text before the value, e.g. Volume, Sound, "- Volume". Leave empty for none.
data_description.mute_entity: A switch / input_boolean (e.g. switch.isp_mute). Leave empty to use the media player's own mute.
data_description.value_offset: Only used when Value shown as = Custom.
data_description.value_scale: Only used when Value shown as = Custom.
data_description.value_suffix: Text right after the value, e.g. %, " dB", " -".
data_description.volume_entity: A number / input_number (e.g. number.isp_volume_level) or a media_player (uses its volume_level).
data_description.volume_full_scale: Value that draws a full bar, in the entity's units (e.g. 80 on a 0-100 slider, 0.8 for a media player). Leave empty for the entity's maximum.

volume_display.description: Show volume and mute changes from another entity (AVR / processor) on the Lumagen OSD. No automation needed. After Submit you'll see a preview before saving.
volume_display.title: Volume Display

volume_preview.description:
How the OSD will look (30 characters per line, solid cells shown as a block):

volume_preview.title: Volume Display Preview
